title_guess: Rain, Steam, and Speed – The Great Western Railway

objects.label: Steam locomotive
objects.sound_prompt: Steam locomotive chuffing hard across a viaduct, whistle in the rain
objects.description: A Great Western Railway engine rushing toward us out of the rain. Its dark funnel and the red glow at its front are the sharpest marks in a painting where almost everything else dissolves.

objects.label: Hare on the track
objects.sound_prompt: A hare darting across wet gravel, quick soft footfalls
objects.description: A hare running along the track ahead of the train, nature's speed against the machine's. Turner brushed it on thinly at the end, and the paint has grown so clear with age that it is now hard to see.

objects.label: Rowing boat
objects.sound_prompt: Oars dipping gently into a calm river, wooden boat creaking
objects.description: A small boat with people in it, out on the river at the lower left. It is only a few quick touches of paint, a slow, quiet counterpoint to the speeding train.

objects.label: Railway viaduct
objects.sound_prompt: Train wheels rumbling over a brick viaduct, deep echoing clatter
objects.description: Brunel's railway bridge at Maidenhead, carrying the line over the Thames. Its brown brick edge cuts in from the corner and races to the horizon, a steep perspective that makes the train feel fast.

objects.label: River Thames
objects.sound_prompt: Rain falling steadily on a wide calm river
objects.description: The River Thames, crossed by both bridges. It is laid in thin, pale washes of cream and grey, so the water, the mist and the rain seem to melt together.

objects.label: Old road bridge
objects.sound_prompt: A distant horse and cart crossing an old stone bridge
objects.description: The older stone road bridge at Maidenhead, built in the 1770s. Its pale arches and their reflections are only softly suggested, a calm contrast with the new railway.

objects.label: Steam and smoke
objects.sound_prompt: Hissing steam bursting from a locomotive chimney, soft whoosh
objects.description: Puffs of white steam from the engine blurring into the rain and mist. Turner keeps them small and soft, so it is hard to tell where the machine ends and the weather begins.

objects.label: Rain-swept sky
objects.sound_prompt: Heavy rain and gusting wind sweeping across open countryside
objects.description: A sky full of driving rain over the Thames valley. In the centre and upper right the paint is laid on thickly, partly with a palette knife, and patches of blue break through the yellow and grey.
